entries.etymology_notes: Inherited from Arabic analytic genitive marker تَاع (tā‘), formed through apheresis of initial m- from Classical and Maghrebi Arabic مَتَاع (matā‘, 'goods, property, belonging to'; Aquilina 1973: 53). Cognate with Maghrebi Arabic mtā‘ (Tunisian and Moroccan) and Egyptian bitā‘. In Maltese, ta' functions both as an analytic preposition introducing genitive noun phrases and as a base that combines with pronominal clitics to form independent possessive pronouns. The paradigm displays phonologically conditioned imāla: the historical root vowel ā raises to ie before vowel-initial suffixes (1sg tiegħi, 2sg tiegħek, 3sg.m tiegħu), but remains a before consonant-initial suffixes (3sg.f tagħha, 1pl tagħna, 2pl tagħkom, 3pl tagħhom).

definitions.text_en: of, belonging to; used as a genitive and possessive marker linking a possessed noun to its possessor or owner
definitions.text_mt: Prepożizzjoni ewlenija u partikella tal-ġenittiv użata biex tindika pussess, sjieda, jew rabta bejn żewġ ismijiet (eż. il-ktieb ta' Pawlu, il-belt ta' Valletta).

definitions.text_en: used with pronominal suffix clitics as an inflected possessive pronoun base expressing 'mine', 'yours', 'his', 'hers', 'ours', 'theirs'
definitions.text_mt: Għamla bażika li tintuża bi pronomi mehmuża (milħuqa) biex tifforma pronomi possessivi indipendenti: tiegħi, tiegħek, tiegħu, tagħha, tagħna, tagħkom, tagħhom.

definitions.text_en: indicating material, substance, composition, origin, type, or occupation (e.g. ċurkett tad-deheb, għalliem tal-Malti, raġel ta' kelma)
definitions.text_mt: Tindika materjal, għamla, oriġini, professjoni jew kwalità ta' persuna jew ħaġa (eż. kaxxa tal-injam, tabib tat-tfal, bniedem ta' rispett).

alternative_forms.notes: Proclitic form used before words beginning with a vowel or silent h (għ) (e.g. t'Alla, t'għada, t'issa).

entries.audit_notes: Solidified lemma entry representing genitive preposition ta' and the complete possessive clitic paradigm (tiegħi, tiegħek, tiegħu, tagħha, tagħna, tagħkom, tagħhom), consolidating former fragmented clitic entries (#3 tiegħu, #42 tagħhom, #124 tagħna, #156 tiegħek, #167 tagħha, #187 tiegħi).

entries.etymology_notes: Formed from the comparative base bħal with the suffix -a, functioning as a role and capacity marker ('in the role of, serving as'). Does not take pronominal suffix clitics directly; personal reference is expressed via personal pronouns (eż. bħala jien) or via bħal with clitics (eż. bħali).

definitions.text_en: as, in the capacity of, serving as (preposition introducing a function, role, title, or profession; e.g. ħadem bħala għalliem, tkellem bħala avukat)
definitions.text_mt: Prepożizzjoni li tispjega r-rwol, il-kariga, il-funzjoni jew il-pożizzjoni uffiċjali ta' persuna jew ħaġa (eż. ħadem bħala għalliem, tkellem bħala rappreżentant).

definitions.text_en: as for, regarding, in terms of (introducing a topic, qualification, or standpoint; e.g. bħala eżempju, bħala regola ġenerali)
definitions.text_mt: Tintroduċi kunsiderazzjoni, eżempju jew punt di vista (eż. bħala eżempju, bħala regola ġenerali, bħala prinċipju).

entries.etymology_notes: Inherited from Arabic preposition عَلَى (ʻalā, 'on, upon, against, for'). In Maltese, through semantic shift and merger with benefactive senses, għal functions primarily as 'for' and 'to', while fuq took over the core locative sense 'on, upon'. When inflected with pronominal suffixes, the historical weak glide reappears giving stem għali-: 1sg għalija, 2sg għalik, 3sg.m għalih, 3sg.f għaliha, 1pl għalina, 2pl għalikom, 3pl għalihom.

entries.etymology_notes: Inherited from Arabic preposition and adverb فَوْقَ (fawqa, 'above, over, upon'). In Maltese, fuq became the primary preposition for 'on, upon, on top of', while also maintaining its adverbial sense ('upwards, above') and topical sense ('about, concerning').

definitions.text_en: on, upon, on top of (spatial preposition indicating location on a surface or upper contact; e.g. fuq il-mejda, fuq il-bejt)
definitions.text_mt: Prepożizzjoni spazjali ewlenija li tindika kuntatt ma' wiċċ jew pożizzjoni fuq nett (eż. fuq il-mejda, fuq il-bejt).

definitions.text_en: about, concerning, regarding (topical preposition, synonymous with dwar; e.g. ktieb fuq l-istorja, tkellimna fuq ix-xogħol)

definitions.text_en: up, upwards, above, upstairs (adverb of place indicating higher position or elevation; e.g. tela' fuq)
definitions.text_mt: Adverbju ta' post li jindika moviment jew pożizzjoni 'l fuq (eż. tela' fuq).

entries.etymology_notes: Inherited from Arabic comitative preposition مَعَ (maʻa, 'with'). In Maltese, citation ma' ends orthographically with an apostrophe representing the historical pharyngeal ʻayn. When taking pronominal suffixes, the root għ reappears and the stem exhibits syllable-conditioned imāla: miegħ- before vowel-initial suffixes (1sg miegħi, 2sg miegħek, 3sg.m miegħu) vs. magħ- before consonant-initial suffixes (3sg.f magħha, 1pl magħna, 2pl magħkom, 3pl magħhom). Distinct from the preverbal negative particle ma ('not').

definitions.text_en: with, accompanied by, in the company of, together with (comitative preposition, e.g. mar ma' ħuh, tkellimt ma' Pawlu)
definitions.text_mt: Prepożizzjoni ewlenija li tindika kumpanija, akkumpanjament jew rabta bejn persuni jew oġġetti (eż. ħareġ ma' ħbiebu, tkellimt ma' Marija).

definitions.text_en: at the same time as, upon, at (temporal co-occurrence, e.g. mas-sebħ, ma' nżul ix-xemx, ma' kull pass)
definitions.text_mt: F'ħin wieħed ma' jew mal-bidu ta' ġrajja (relazzjoni temporali; eż. mas-sebħ, ma' tlugħ ix-xemx).

definitions.text_en: inflected with pronominal suffix clitics as an independent pronoun base (miegħi, miegħek, miegħu, magħha, magħna, magħkom, magħhom)
definitions.text_mt: Għamla bażika li tieħu pronomi mehmuża: miegħi, miegħek, miegħu, magħha, magħna, magħkom, magħhom.

entries.etymology_notes: Inherited from Arabic preposition فِي (fī, 'in, inside, at'). Forms the proclitic f' before vowel-initial words and silent letters, and fuses with the definite article as fil- (with regular coronal assimilations fit-, fid-, fin-, fir-, fis-, fix-, fiż-, fiz-, fiċ-). Takes pronominal suffix clitics on the lengthened stem fi-: 1sg fija, 2sg fik, 3sg.m fih, 3sg.f fiha, 1pl fina, 2pl fikom, 3pl fihom.

definitions.text_en: in, inside, within, at (spatial preposition indicating location, containment, or presence within an area, boundary, or container; e.g. fi darna, fi pjazza, fi flixkun)
definitions.text_mt: Prepożizzjoni spazjali ewlenija li tindika qagħda, pożizzjoni jew konteniment ġewwa post, bini, kontenitur jew limitu (eż. fid-dar, fi pjazza, f'kamra).

definitions.text_en: in, during, at (temporal preposition indicating a period of time, season, month, or point in time; e.g. f'April, fis-sajf, filgħodu)

definitions.text_mt: Tindika stat, kundizzjoni, qagħda tal-moħħ jew ċirkostanza li fiha tinsab persuna jew ħaġa (eż. fil-paċi, fis-skiet, f'inkwiet kbir).

entries.etymology_notes: Inherited from Arabic preposition مِنْ (min, 'from, out of, of'). Fuses with the definite article as mill- (assimilating before coronals to mit-, mid-, min-, mir-, mis-, mix-, miż-, miz-, miċ-). Takes pronominal suffix clitics with doubled n: 1sg minni, 2sg minnek, 3sg.m minnu, 3sg.f minnha, 1pl minna, 2pl minnkom, 3pl minnhom.

definitions.text_en: from, away from, out of (ablative preposition indicating starting point, point of departure, origin, or source in space; e.g. minn Malta, minn fuq il-bejt)
definitions.text_mt: Prepożizzjoni ewlenija li tindika sors, punt tat-tluq, oriġini jew provenjenza spazjali (eż. minn Malta, minn raħal għal ieħor, minn ġewwa).

definitions.text_mt: Prepożizzjoni ta' żmien li tindika bidu ta' medda jew perijodu (eż. minn kmieni, minn sbieħ il-jum).

definitions.text_en: out of, of, from among (indicating material, substance, composition, or partitive selection; e.g. magħmul mill-injam, wieħed minnhom)
definitions.text_mt: Tindika materjal jew sustanza li minnha hija magħmula xi ħaġa, jew għażla partittiva minn grupp (eż. magħmul mill-injam, wieħed minnhom).

definitions.text_en: from, because of, through, by (indicating cause, reason, or channel; e.g. miet bil-ġuħ jew minn xi marda, minn rajh)

entries.etymology_notes: Inherited from Arabic definite article prefix اَلْ (al-). In Maltese, the definite article has two principal orthographic shapes: il- (used when following or preceding consonant clusters) and l- (used after vowels or directly prefixed before single-consonant vowel-initial bases). Before coronal consonants (sun letters: ċ, d, n, r, s, t, x, ż, z), the lateral consonant assimilates completely: iċ-, id-, in-, ir-, is-, it-, ix-, iż-, iz- (or ċ-, d-, n-, r-, s-, t-, x-, ż-, z- after a vowel).

alternative_forms.notes: Full form of the definite article used before consonant-initial words.

entries.etymology_notes: Inherited from Arabic compound prepositional phrase بِحَال (bi-ħāl, 'in the state of, in the manner of, like'). Fuses with the definite article as bħall- (e.g. bħall-bieraħ, bħall-ilma). Takes standard possessive clitics: 1sg bħali, 2sg bħalek, 3sg.m bħalu, 3sg.f bħalha, 1pl bħalna, 2pl bħalkom, 3pl bħalhom.

definitions.text_en: such as, like, for instance (introducing examples or representative items in an enumeration; e.g. frott bħal tuffieħ u larinġ)

entries.etymology_notes: Inherited from Arabic adjective قَرِيب (qarīb, 'near, close, relative'), from root q-r-b ('to be near'). In Maltese, functions both as a spatial and temporal adjective of proximity ('near, close by') and prepositionally as a relator followed directly by a noun phrase or prepositional complement (eż. qrib il-knisja, qrib nofsinhar). Forms the lexicalized adverbial phrases fil-qrib ('nearby') and mill-qrib ('closely').

definitions.text_en: near, close, nearby, adjacent to (spatial adjective and relator indicating short physical distance to a location, person, or landmark; e.g. qrib il-baħar, qrib il-pjazza)
definitions.text_mt: Aġġettiv u relatur spazjali li jindika distanza qasira ħafna minn post, bini jew persuna (eż. qrib il-baħar, qrib il-knisja, qrib id-dar).

definitions.text_en: close to, near, approaching (temporal relator indicating a point in time close to an hour, event, or season; e.g. qrib nofsinhar, qrib il-festa)
definitions.text_mt: Relatur temporali li jindika ħin jew data qrib ħafna ta' ġrajja jew siegħa (eż. qrib nofsinhar, qrib tmiem ix-xahar).

definitions.text_en: close, intimate, related (expressing intimate friendship, strong personal bond, or family relation)
definitions.text_mt: Tindika rabta personali mill-qrib, familjarità jew rabta ta' demm (eż. ħabib qrib ħafna tiegħi).

usage_examples.mt: Il-ħanut jinsab qrib il-pjazza prinċipali tar-raħal.

usage_examples.mt: Huwa ħabib qrib ħafna li ilu jaf lill-familja tagħna għal snin twal.
usage_examples.en: He is a very close friend who has known our family for many years.

alternative_forms.notes: Locative adverbial phrase meaning 'nearby, in the vicinity'.
Adverbial phrase meaning 'closely, at close quarters'.

entries.audit_notes: Refined lemma entry for spatial, temporal, and relational adjective and relator qrib with cross-links to derived adverbial phrases fil-qrib and mill-qrib.

entries.etymology_notes: Inherited from Arabic preposition and adverb وَرَاء (warāʾ, 'behind, beyond, after'). In Maltese, wara behaves morphophonologically as a weak glide stem with final radical -j (root w-r-j), inserting an intervocalic glide -j- before pronominal suffix clitics: 1sg warajja, 2sg warajk, 3sg.m warajh, 3sg.f warajha, 1pl warajna, 2pl warajkom, 3pl warajhom.

definitions.text_en: behind, at the back of, in the rear of (spatial relation indicating location to the rear of someone or something)
definitions.text_mt: Fin-naħa jew fil-parti ta' wara ta' persuna, oġġett jew post (relazzjoni spazjali).

definitions.text_en: after, subsequent to, later than; following in time, order, or sequence (e.g. wara l-ikel, wara xulxin)
definitions.text_mt: F'ħin ta' wara (aktar tard minn) jew f'sekwenza (eż. wara l-ikel, wara xulxin).

usage_examples.mt: It-tfal qagħdu jilagħbu fil-ġnien ta' wara d-dar.
usage_examples.en: The children were playing in the garden behind the house.

usage_examples.mt: Niltaqgħu wara l-quddies biex nitkellmu ftit.
usage_examples.en: We will meet after mass to talk for a while.

usage_examples.mt: Agħlaq il-bieb warajk meta toħroġ mill-kamra.
usage_examples.en: Close the door behind you when you leave the room.

alternative_forms.notes: Locative phrase meaning 'from behind, in the rear'.

entries.audit_notes: Refined lemma entry for spatial and temporal preposition wara with full pronominal clitic paradigm and academic citations.

entries.etymology_notes: Inherited from Arabic preposition and adverb تَحْتَ (taḥta, 'under, below, beneath'). Functions both as a primary spatial preposition and as a condition relator ('under control, under age').

definitions.text_en: under, beneath, underneath, below (spatial preposition indicating location underneath or covered by something; e.g. taħt il-mejda, taħt is-siġra)
definitions.text_mt: Prepożizzjoni spazjali ewlenija li tindika post jew livell aktar baxx minn xi ħaġa, jew taħt il-qiegħ ta' oġġett (eż. taħt il-mejda, taħt is-siġra).

definitions.text_en: under, subjected to, subordinate to, in the condition of (indicating governance, supervision, or state; e.g. taħt il-kontroll, taħt il-ħakma, taħt l-età)
definitions.text_mt: Tindika stat, tmexxija, kundizzjoni jew dipendenza (eż. taħt kontroll, taħt l-età, taħt pressjoni).

definitions.text_en: below, down, downstairs (adverb of place indicating lower position)
definitions.text_mt: Adverbju ta' post li jindika pożizzjoni 'l isfel jew f'livell inferjuri.

usage_examples.mt: Il-qattus qed jorqod taħt il-mejda fil-kċina.
usage_examples.en: The cat is sleeping under the table in the kitchen.

usage_examples.mt: Is-sitwazzjoni issa tinsab taħt kontroll sħiħ.
usage_examples.en: The situation is now under complete control.

alternative_forms.notes: Compound prepositional and adverbial phrase meaning 'from underneath, secretly, underhand'.

entries.etymology_notes: Borrowed from Italian per mezzo (di) ('by means of'). In Maltese, permezz combines with the genitive preposition ta' to function as a compound preposition meaning 'by means of, through, via'.

definitions.text_en: by means of, through, via (used with ta' as a compound preposition)
definitions.text_mt: b'mezz ta'; bl-għajnuna jew bl-intermedju ta' (fil-frażi 'permezz ta'')

usage_examples.mt: L-istudenti applikaw għall-kors permezz tal-internet.
usage_examples.en: The students applied for the course through (by means of) the internet.

usage_examples.mt: Irnexxielu jikseb ir-riżultat permezz ta' xogħol iebes.
usage_examples.en: He managed to achieve the result through hard work.

entries.etymology_notes: Inherited from Arabic temporal preposition and adverb قَبْلَ (qabla, 'before, prior to'). In Maltese, functions as the primary preposition of anterior time ('before a point in time or event') and combines with the relative marker ma as the subordinating conjunction qabel ma ('before'). Takes pronominal suffix clitics with epenthetic vowel breaking consonant clusters: 1sg qabli, 2sg qablek, 3sg.m qablu, 3sg.f qabilha, 1pl qabilna, 2pl qabilkom, 3pl qabilhom.

definitions.text_en: before, prior to, earlier than (temporal preposition indicating an earlier point in time, preceding an event, date, or hour; e.g. qabel l-ikel, qabel nofsinhar, qabel il-festa)
definitions.text_mt: Prepożizzjoni temporali ewlenija li tindika ħin jew mument aktar kmieni minn ġrajja, data jew siegħa stabbilita (eż. qabel l-ikel, qabel nofsinhar, qabel il-laqgħa).

definitions.text_en: before, previously, beforehand, earlier (adverb indicating a prior occasion or earlier state; e.g. kif għedtilkom qabel, kont naf bih qabel)
definitions.text_mt: Adverbju ta' żmien li jfisser qatt qabel, aktar kmieni jew f'okkażjoni preċedenti (eż. kif għedtilkom qabel, ma rajtu qatt qabel).

usage_examples.mt: Wasal l-uffiċċju qabel il-ħin stabbilit tal-laqgħa.
usage_examples.en: He arrived at the office before the appointed meeting time.

usage_examples.mt: Aħsel idejk sewwa qabel l-ikel.
usage_examples.en: Wash your hands thoroughly before eating.

usage_examples.mt: Kif semmejna qabel, ir-riżultati se jitħabbru għada.
usage_examples.en: As we mentioned before, the results will be announced tomorrow.

alternative_forms.notes: Conjunctional phrase introducing temporal subordinate clauses ('before').

entries.audit_notes: Refined lemma entry for primary temporal preposition and adverb qabel with cleaned Maltese definition, etymological notes, and regularized epenthetic clitic paradigm.

entries.etymology_notes: Inherited from Arabic root d-w-r (د-و-ر, 'to turn, circle'), related to دَوَار (dawār, 'circuit, rotation, around') and cognate with Maltese noun dawra ('turn, circuit') and compound preposition madwar ('around'). Functions primarily as an abstract topical preposition ('about, regarding') and secondarily in locative (circumferential) contexts.

definitions.text_en: about, concerning, regarding, on the subject of (e.g. ktieb dwar l-istorja, tkellimna dwar il-proġett)
definitions.text_mt: Prepożizzjoni topika li tindika s-suġġett jew il-materja li qed titqies jew tiġi diskussa (eż. ktieb dwar l-istorja, diskursata dwar ix-xogħol).

definitions.text_en: around, round about, on all sides of (locative, often in dawra dwar)
definitions.text_mt: Fin-naħat kollha ta' oġġett jew post (relazzjoni spazjali u ċirkonferenzjali).

usage_examples.mt: Il-ministru għamel diskors twil dwar il-futur tal-edukazzjoni.
usage_examples.en: The minister gave a long speech about the future of education.

usage_examples.mt: Ma nafx x'taf int dwaru, imma hu bniedem onest ħafna.
usage_examples.en: I don't know what you know about him, but he is a very honest person.

usage_examples.mt: Kien hemm ħafna mistoqsijiet dwarna wara l-laqgħa.
usage_examples.en: There were many questions about us after the meeting.

entries.audit_notes: Corrected from erroneous noun definition ('surroundings') to primary preposition 'about, concerning' with full pronominal clitic paradigm.

entries.etymology_notes: Inherited from Arabic preposition بَيْنَ (bayna, 'between, among'). Functions as a spatial, temporal, and relational relator connecting two or more entities. In Maltese morphology, personal clitics attach exclusively to the pluralized construct base bejniet-: 1pl bejnietna ('between us'), 2pl bejnietkom ('between you'), 3pl bejniethom ('between them'). Singular personal relations are expressed analytically as bejni u bejn... ('between me and...').

definitions.text_en: between (spatial preposition indicating an intermediate position separating two points, places, objects, or boundaries; e.g. bejn il-knisja u l-isptar, bejn żewġ siġriet)
definitions.text_mt: Prepożizzjoni spazjali li tindika qagħda intermedja jew spazju fin-nofs li jifred żewġ postijiet, oġġetti jew persuni (eż. bejn il-knisja u l-iskola, bejn żewġ ħitan).

definitions.text_en: between (temporal preposition indicating an intermediate interval of time, age, or quantity; e.g. bejn it-tlieta u l-erbgħa, bejn l-għaxar u t-tnax-il sena)
definitions.text_mt: Prepożizzjoni temporali jew kwantitattiva li tindika medda jew intervall bejn żewġ punti (eż. bejn id-disgħa u l-għaxra, bejn għoxrin u tletin ewro).

definitions.text_en: between, among (indicating mutual interaction, comparison, distinction, agreement, or dispute between parties; e.g. qbil bejnietna, id-differenza bejn it-tnejn)
definitions.text_mt: Tindika relazzjoni reċiproka, ftehim, qasma jew distinzjoni bejn partijiet (eż. ftehim bejnietna, id-differenza bejn il-verità u l-gideb).

usage_examples.mt: Il-ħanut jinsab bejn il-knisja u l-isptar.
usage_examples.en: The shop is located between the church and the hospital.

usage_examples.mt: It-tabib ikun fil-klinika bejn l-erbgħa u s-sebgħa ta' filgħaxija.
usage_examples.en: The doctor is at the clinic between four and seven in the evening.

usage_examples.mt: Żammejna dan is-sigriet bejnietna biex ma ninkwetaw lil ħadd.
usage_examples.en: We kept this secret between us so as not to worry anyone.

alternative_forms.notes: Construct plural base used before pronominal suffix clitics (bejnietna, bejnietkom, bejniethom).

entries.audit_notes: Refined lemma entry for spatial, temporal, and reciprocal preposition bejn with documented plural construct clitic paradigm (bejnietna..bejniethom).

entries.etymology_notes: Inherited from the Arabic phrase فِي وَسْطِ (fī wasṭi, 'in the middle of, in the midst of'). In Maltese, functions as a collective spatial and partitive preposition indicating inclusion within a group, crowd, or collection of multiple entities. Takes plural pronominal suffix clitics: 1pl fostna, 2pl fostkom, 3pl fosthom.

definitions.text_en: among, amidst, in the midst of, surrounded by (spatial preposition indicating location in the middle of a crowd, group, or collection; e.g. fost il-folla, fost is-siġar)
definitions.text_mt: Prepożizzjoni spazjali li tindika qagħda f'nofs folla, grupp ta' nies jew għadd ta' oġġetti (eż. fost il-folla, fost is-siġar fil-masġar).

definitions.text_en: among, out of (partitive preposition indicating inclusion, membership, or selection within a community or set; e.g. fost l-aqwa studenti, qbil fost il-membri)
definitions.text_mt: Tindika sħubija, inklużjoni jew relazzjoni fi ħdan grupp, soċjetà jew komunità (eż. qbil fost il-membri kollha, fost l-aqwa atleti ta' pajjiżna).

usage_examples.mt: Sabu qbil sħiħ fost il-membri kollha tal-kumitat.
usage_examples.en: They found complete agreement among all committee members.

usage_examples.mt: Kien diffiċli li tarah fost il-folla kbira tan-nies fil-pjazza.
usage_examples.en: It was difficult to spot him among the large crowd of people in the square.

usage_examples.mt: Huwa magħruf bħala mexxej għaref u maħbub fostna.
usage_examples.en: He is known as a wise and beloved leader among us.

alternative_forms.notes: Partitive phrase meaning 'from among, out of'.

entries.audit_notes: Refined lemma entry for collective and partitive preposition fost with documented plural clitic paradigm and partitive phrase minn fost.

entries.etymology_notes: Inherited from Arabic preposition and adverb قُدَّامَ (quddāma, 'in front of, ahead, before'). Maltese exhibits imāla raising ā to ie (quddām > quddiem). Functions as a primary spatial preposition and temporal prospective relator.

definitions.text_en: in front of, before, facing (spatial preposition indicating location ahead of or directly facing someone or something; e.g. quddiem il-knisja, quddiem il-bieb)
definitions.text_mt: Prepożizzjoni spazjali ewlenija li tindika pożizzjoni faċċata jew fuq in-naħa ta' quddiem ta' persuna, oġġett jew bini (eż. quddiem il-knisja, quddiem il-bieb).

definitions.text_en: before, in the presence of (in front of a person, authority, or gathering; e.g. quddiem l-imħallef, quddiem kulħadd)
definitions.text_mt: Fil-preżenza jew quddiem għajnejn xi ħadd, partikolarment awtorità jew udjenza (eż. quddiem il-qorti, quddiem kulħadd).

definitions.text_en: ahead, forward, before (adverb of place and prospective time; e.g. 'l quddiem)
definitions.text_mt: Adverbju ta' post ('il quddiem) jew ta' żmien prospettiv li jħares lejn il-ġejjieni.

usage_examples.mt: Waqafna quddiem il-bieb prinċipali tal-iskola.
usage_examples.en: We stopped in front of the school's main door.

usage_examples.mt: Iċ-xhud tela' jitkellem quddiem l-imħallef.
usage_examples.en: The witness went up to speak before the judge.

usage_examples.mt: Għandna diversi sfidi importanti 'l quddiem.
usage_examples.en: We have several important challenges ahead (in the future).

alternative_forms.notes: Adverbial directional and temporal phrase meaning 'forward, ahead, in the future'.
Locative phrase meaning 'from the front, past the front'.

entries.audit_notes: 🔄 *(Duplicate: also at #922)*

entries.etymology_notes: Inherited from Arabic compound phrase إِلَى أَيْنَ (ʾilā ʾayna, 'to where, toward'). In Maltese, the final nasal assimilates with the initial palatal glide of the pronominal suffix to form geminate -jj-: 1sg lejja, 2sg lejk, 3sg.m lejh, 3sg.f lejha, 1pl lejna, 2pl lejkom, 3pl lejhom.

definitions.text_en: towards, toward, in the direction of (spatial preposition indicating movement, heading, or orientation toward a location or person; e.g. mexa lejn il-port, ħares lejn is-sema)
definitions.text_mt: Prepożizzjoni spazjali ta' moviment u direzzjoni li tindika orjentazzjoni jew passaġġ lejn post, persuna jew oġġett (eż. mexa lejn il-baħar, ħares lejn it-tieqa).

definitions.text_en: towards, toward (expressing attitude, disposition, sentiment, or duty toward someone; e.g. rispett lejn l-anzjani, mħabba lejn il-proxxmu)
definitions.text_mt: Tindika attitudni, sentiment, rispett jew dmir lejn persuna jew kawża (eż. rispett lejn il-ġenituri, ġenerożità lejn min hu fil-bżonn).

definitions.text_en: towards, around, close to (temporal preposition indicating an approximate time or period; e.g. lejn l-aħħar tax-xahar, lejn nofsinhar)
definitions.text_mt: Prepożizzjoni temporali li tindika ħin jew perijodu approssimattiv (eż. lejn inżul ix-xemx, lejn tmiem is-sena).

usage_examples.mt: Mxejna bil-mod lejn il-port biex naraw il-vapuri deħlin.
usage_examples.en: We walked slowly towards the port to see the incoming ships.

usage_examples.mt: Dejjem wera rispett kbir lejn l-għalliema tiegħu.
usage_examples.en: He always showed great respect towards his teachers.

usage_examples.mt: Wasal lura d-dar lejn l-erbgħa ta' wara nofsinhar.
usage_examples.en: He arrived back home towards four in the afternoon.

entries.audit_notes: Refined lemma entry for directional, attitudinal, and approximative preposition lejn with complete assimilated pronominal clitic paradigm (lejja..lejhom).

entries.etymology_notes: Borrowed from Sicilian and Italian contra (from Latin contrā, 'against, opposite'). Integrated into Maltese prepositional morphology as a loanword taking the standard vocalic pronominal suffix paradigm on the lengthened stem kontri-: 1sg kontrija, 2sg kontrik, 3sg.m kontrih, 3sg.f kontriha, 1pl kontrina, 2pl kontrikom, 3pl kontrihom.

definitions.text_en: against, opposed to, in conflict with (preposition expressing opposition, disagreement, adversary relation, or conflict; e.g. kontra l-gwerra, ivvota kontra l-proposta)
definitions.text_mt: Prepożizzjoni ewlenija li tindika oppożizzjoni, nuqqas ta' qbil jew kompetizzjoni (eż. ivvutaw kontra l-mozzjoni, lagħbu kontra tim b'saħħtu).

definitions.text_en: against, contrary to, in violation of (indicating violation or breach of rules, law, conscience, or nature; e.g. kontra l-liġi, kontra r-regoli)
definitions.text_mt: Tindika ksur ta' liġi, kodiċi, regola jew prinċipju morali (eż. kontra l-liġi, kontra l-ordni pubbliku, kontra r-regolamenti).

definitions.text_en: against, upon (indicating physical contact, pressure, or impact against a surface; e.g. laqat rasu kontra l-ħajt, imbotta kontra l-bieb)
definitions.text_mt: Tindika kuntatt jew impatt fiżiku ma' wiċċ jew oġġett ieħor (eż. ħabat kontra l-ħajt, imbotta kontra l-bieb magħluq).

usage_examples.mt: Votaw kontra l-proposta l-ġdida matul il-laqgħa tal-parlament.
usage_examples.en: They voted against the new proposal during the parliamentary meeting.

usage_examples.mt: Is-sewqan b'veloċità eċċessiva huwa għal kollox kontra l-liġi.
usage_examples.en: Driving at excessive speed is completely against the law.

usage_examples.mt: Il-mewġ qawwi kien qed iħabbat bla heda kontra l-blat tal-kosta.
usage_examples.en: The strong waves were pounding ceaselessly against the coastal rocks.

entries.audit_notes: Refined lemma entry for oppositive, regulatory, and contact preposition kontra with full Sicilian loanword etymology and pronominal clitic paradigm (kontrija..kontrihom).

entries.etymology_notes: Inherited from Arabic طُول (ṭūl, 'length, duration'). In Maltese, the nominal base tul is grammaticalized as an improper (nominal) preposition denoting spatial path ('along') and temporal duration ('throughout, during'). Related to matul ('during, throughout').

definitions.text_en: along, following the length of (spatial path, e.g. tul it-triq, tul il-kosta)
definitions.text_mt: Matul it-tul ta' post, triq jew medda (relazzjoni spazjali; eż. tul it-triq, tul ix-xatt).

definitions.text_en: throughout, during, all through, for the entire duration of (temporal duration, e.g. tul il-jum, tul is-snin, tul ħajtu)
definitions.text_mt: Tul il-ħin kollu jew matul iż-żmien kollu ta' ġrajja (relazzjoni temporali; eż. tul il-jum kollu, tul is-snin, tul ħajtu).

usage_examples.mt: Mixjin bil-mod tul ix-xatt biex igawdu l-arja friska tal-baħar.
usage_examples.en: They walked slowly along the promenade to enjoy the fresh sea breeze.

usage_examples.mt: Ħadem bla waqfien tul il-lejl kollu biex ilesti x-xogħol fil-ħin.
usage_examples.en: He worked non-stop throughout the entire night to finish the work on time.

entries.audit_notes: Corrected from nominal definition ('length, height') to prepositional usage ('along, throughout, during').

entries.etymology_notes: Inherited from Arabic preposition لِـ (li-, 'to, for'), historically reinforced or reduplicated in Maltese as lil. Functions as the primary differential object marker before definite human or specific noun phrases and takes pronominal suffix clitics: lili, lilek, lilu, lilha, lilna, lilkom, lilhom.

definitions.text_en: to, toward, for; accusative and dative preposition marking direct definite objects (differential object marker) and indirect objects
definitions.text_mt: Prepożizzjoni ewlenija li tintuża biex tindika l-oġġett dirett definit (markatur tal-oġġett) jew l-oġġett indirett; lil persuna jew ħaġa (eż. rajtu lil Pawlu, għidtilha lil Marija).
definitions.nuance: differential object marker and dative preposition

definitions.text_en: towards, in the direction of (spatial movement, synonymous with lejn in fixed phrases)
definitions.text_mt: Fid-direzzjoni ta'; lejn (fil-frażijiet bħal 'l hawn, 'l hemm, 'l fuq).

usage_examples.mt: Għaddi l-ktieb lil Mario.
usage_examples.en: Pass the book to Mario.

usage_examples.mt: Rajt lil oħti l-bieraħ filgħaxija.
usage_examples.en: I saw my sister yesterday evening.

alternative_forms.notes: Proclitic reduced form used before nouns and directional adverbs (e.g. 'l fuq, 'l quddiem, 'l hemm).

entries.etymology_notes: Proclitic reduction of preposition lil ('to, towards').

definitions.text_en: to, towards (proclitic directional and object preposition, shortened variant of lil)
definitions.text_mt: Għamla mqassra tal-prepożizzjoni 'lil' li tintrabat ma' kliem direzzjonali jew ismijiet (eż. 'l fuq, 'l isfel, 'l hemm, 'l quddiem).

usage_examples.mt: Ħares 'l fuq u ra l-ajruplan.
usage_examples.en: He looked upwards and saw the airplane.

usage_examples.mt: Imxejna 'l quddiem bil-mod.
usage_examples.en: We walked forward slowly.

entries.etymology_notes: Inherited from Arabic definite article prefix اَلْ (al-). In Maltese, il- represents the full form used before consonant-initial words.

definitions.text_en: the (definite article; full form used before consonant-initial words and consonant clusters)
definitions.text_mt: L-artiklu definit fil-forma sħiħa tiegħu, użat quddiem kliem li jibda b'konsonanti (minbarra l-konsonanti xemxin) jew grupp ta' konsonanti (eż. il-ktieb, il-belt, il-skola).

usage_examples.mt: Il-ktieb jinsab fuq il-mejda.
usage_examples.en: The book is on the table.

usage_examples.mt: Il-belt kapitali hija l-Belt Valletta.
usage_examples.en: The capital city is Valletta.

alternative_forms.notes: Proclitic reduced form before vowels or after vowel-final words.

entries.etymology_notes: Proclitic reduction of preposition ta' before vowel-initial words and silent letters.

definitions.text_en: of (proclitic genitive marker shortened from ta' before vowel-initial words or silent għ or h)
definitions.text_mt: Għamla mqassra tal-prepożizzjoni 'ta'', użata quddiem kliem li jibda b'vokali jew b'għ (eż. t'Alla, t'għada, t'issa).

usage_examples.mt: Il-pjanijiet t'għada huma lesti.
usage_examples.en: Tomorrow's plans are ready.

usage_examples.mt: Għamilna l-laqgħa t'issa.
usage_examples.en: We held the current meeting.

entries.etymology_notes: Proclitic reduction of preposition ma' before vowel-initial words.

definitions.text_en: with (proclitic comitative preposition shortened from ma' before vowel-initial words or silent għ or h)
definitions.text_mt: Għamla mqassra tal-prepożizzjoni 'ma'', użata quddiem kliem li jibda b'vokali jew b'għ (eż. m'Alla, m'ommu).

usage_examples.mt: Mar il-festa m'ommu.
usage_examples.en: He went to the feast with his mother.

entries.etymology_notes: Proclitic reduction of preposition fi before vowel-initial words.

definitions.text_en: in, inside, at (proclitic locative preposition shortened from fi before vowel-initial words or silent għ or h)
definitions.text_mt: Għamla mqassra tal-prepożizzjoni 'fi', użata quddiem kliem li jibda b'vokali jew b'għ (eż. f'għajnejh, f'idejh, f'April).

usage_examples.mt: Kien hemm id-dmugħ f'għajnejh.
usage_examples.en: There were tears in his eyes.

usage_examples.mt: Il-vaganza se ssir f'Awwissu.
usage_examples.en: The holiday will take place in August.

entries.etymology_notes: Fusion of preposition għal ('for, to') and the definite article il- ('the').

definitions.text_en: for the, to the (contracted fused form of preposition għal and the definite article il-)
definitions.text_mt: Prepożizzjoni artikolata magħquda tal-prepożizzjoni 'għal' mal-artiklu ddeterminat 'il-' (eż. għall-gost, għall-iskola, għall-aħjar).

usage_examples.mt: Ippreparaw kollox għall-ftuħ uffiċjali.
usage_examples.en: They prepared everything for the official opening.

usage_examples.mt: Dan isir għall-ġid ta' kulħadd.
usage_examples.en: This is done for the good of all.

entries.etymology_notes: Variant form of għal preserving final vowel in interrogative and fixed contexts.

definitions.text_en: why, wherefore; variant and interrogative form of preposition għal (e.g. għala le? - why not?)
definitions.text_mt: Għamla varjanti u interrogattiva tal-prepożizzjoni 'għal' użata biex tistaqsi r-raġuni jew l-iskop (eż. għala le?, għala għamilt hekk?).

usage_examples.mt: Għala ma ġejtx għal-laqgħa lbieraħ?
usage_examples.en: Why didn't you come to the meeting yesterday?

entries.etymology_notes: Fusion of comitative preposition ma' ('with') and definite article il- ('the'). Assimilates before coronal consonants (sun letters).

definitions.text_en: with the, alongside the, upon the (contracted fused form of preposition ma' and the definite article il-)
definitions.text_mt: Prepożizzjoni artikolata magħquda tal-prepożizzjoni 'ma'' mal-artiklu ddeterminat 'il-' (tindika kumpanija jew ħin; eż. mal-ħbieb, mas-sebħ).

usage_examples.mt: Qamu mas-sebħ biex jaqbdu l-vapur.
usage_examples.en: They woke up at daybreak (with the dawn) to catch the ship.

usage_examples.mt: Ħareġ mal-ħbieb tiegħu filgħaxija.
usage_examples.en: He went out with his friends in the evening.

entries.etymology_notes: Fusion of ablative preposition minn ('from') and definite article il- ('the'). Assimilates before coronal consonants (sun letters).

definitions.text_en: from the, out of the, through the (contracted fused form of preposition minn and the definite article il-)
definitions.text_mt: Prepożizzjoni artikolata magħquda tal-prepożizzjoni 'minn' mal-artiklu ddeterminat 'il-' (tindika oriġini, sors jew mogħdija; eż. mill-belt, mill-bidu, mit-triq).

usage_examples.mt: Ħareġ mill-bieb ta' wara.
usage_examples.en: He exited through the back door.

usage_examples.mt: Bdejna x-xogħol mill-bidu nett.
usage_examples.en: We started the work right from the beginning.

entries.etymology_notes: Fusion of comparative preposition bħal ('like, as') and definite article il- ('the').

definitions.text_en: like the, as the (contracted fused form of preposition bħal and the definite article il-)
definitions.text_mt: Prepożizzjoni artikolata magħquda tal-prepożizzjoni 'bħal' mal-artiklu ddeterminat 'il-' użata għax-xebh u l-paragun (eż. bħall-ilma, bħar-riħ).

usage_examples.mt: Għadda malajr bħar-riħ.
usage_examples.en: It passed quickly like the wind.

usage_examples.mt: L-ilbies kien abjad bħall-borra.
usage_examples.en: The garment was white like snow.

entries.etymology_notes: Compound formed from preposition ma' ('with') and nominal or prepositional base dwar ('circuit, around'). Functions as a spatial and approximative relator.

definitions.text_en: around, round about, on all sides of (spatial preposition indicating circumference or perimeter)
definitions.text_mt: Prepożizzjoni komposta li tindika ċirkonferenza jew post mad-dawra kollha ta' oġġett jew żona (eż. madwar il-mejda, madwar il-gżira).

definitions.text_en: around, approximately, roughly (approximative marker with numerals and quantities)
definitions.text_mt: Jindika approssimazzjoni ta' numru, ħin jew kwantità; bejn wieħed u ieħor (eż. madwar mitt ruħ, madwar nofsinhar).

usage_examples.mt: Poġġejna l-pultruni madwar il-mejda.
usage_examples.en: We placed the armchairs around the table.

usage_examples.mt: Kien hemm madwar ħamsin persuna fil-sala.
usage_examples.en: There were around fifty people in the hall.

entries.etymology_notes: Compound formed from preposition ma' ('with') and base tul ('length'). Denotes temporal duration and spatial trajectory.

definitions.text_en: during, throughout, for the entire course of (temporal compound preposition from ma' + tul)
definitions.text_mt: Prepożizzjoni komposta li tindika medda sħiħa ta' żmien li matulha sseħħ ġrajja; tul (eż. matul il-jum, matul is-sena, matul il-vaganzi).

definitions.text_en: along, following the length of (spatial trajectory)
definitions.text_mt: Tul il-medda spazjali ta' post jew triq (eż. matul ix-xatt).

usage_examples.mt: Ħdimna bla waqfien matul il-lejl kollu.
usage_examples.en: We worked non-stop throughout the whole night.

usage_examples.mt: Imxejna matul ix-xatt tal-baħar.
usage_examples.en: We walked along the sea shore.

entries.etymology_notes: Calqued from Italian per mezzo di ('by means of'). Combines noun permezz with the genitive preposition ta'.

definitions.text_en: by means of, through, via, by virtue of (compound preposition phrase composed of permezz and ta')
definitions.text_mt: Frażi prepożizzjonali komposta użata biex tindika l-mezz, l-istrument, jew l-intermedju li permezz tiegħu sseħħ xi ħaġa (eż. permezz ta' ittra, permezz tal-internet).

usage_examples.mt: L-istudenti applikaw permezz tal-internet.
usage_examples.en: The students applied through (by means of) the internet.

usage_examples.mt: Irnexxielu jikseb il-promozzjoni permezz ta' xogħol iebes.
usage_examples.en: He managed to obtain the promotion through hard work.

entries.etymology_notes: Compound phrase formed from directional preposition lil ('to, towards') and spatial relator fuq ('above, on').

definitions.text_en: upwards, up, above; directional adverbial phrase composed of preposition lil and spatial relator fuq
definitions.text_mt: Frażi avverbjali direzzjonali li tindika moviment jew pożizzjoni lejn l-għoli (eż. tela' 'l fuq, ħares 'l fuq).

definitions.text_en: upwards of, and above (quantifier indicating more than a given number or age; e.g. minn tmintax-il sena 'l fuq)
definitions.text_mt: Tindika kwantità jew età ogħla minn limitu stabbilit (eż. minn tmintax-il sena 'l fuq).

usage_examples.mt: Ħares 'l fuq u ra l-ajruplan itir.
usage_examples.en: He looked up and saw the airplane flying.

usage_examples.mt: Il-kors huwa miftuħ għal persuni minn tmintax-il sena 'l fuq.
usage_examples.en: The course is open to people aged eighteen and above.

entries.etymology_notes: Interrogative fusion of fuq with the interrogative enclitic -x (from ayy shayʾ).

definitions.text_en: on what? about what? (interrogative prepositional form combining fuq with the enclitic question marker -x, -ie-x)
definitions.text_mt: Għamla interrogattiva magħquda tal-prepożizzjoni 'fuq' mal-partiċella interrogattiva mehmuża '-x' (eż. fuqiex qed titkellmu?, fuqiex poġġejtu?).

usage_examples.mt: Fuqiex qed titkellmu b'daqstant passjoni?
usage_examples.en: What are you talking about with such passion?

entries.etymology_notes: Compound phrase formed from preposition minn ('from') and spatial relator taħt ('under, beneath').

definitions.text_en: from underneath, from below (spatial locative phrase composed of minn and taħt)
definitions.text_mt: Frażi spazjali li tindika moviment jew provenjenza min-naħa t'isfel ta' oġġett (eż. għadda minn taħt il-pont).

definitions.text_en: underhand, surreptitiously, secretly, under the table (idiomatic adverbial)
definitions.text_mt: B'mod moħbi jew b'qerq, minn wara dahar ħaddieħor (eż. għamlu l-ftehim minn taħt).

usage_examples.mt: Għadda minn taħt il-pont biex jilħaq it-triq.
usage_examples.en: He went from under the bridge to reach the road.

usage_examples.mt: Ipprova jgħaddilu l-flus minn taħt.
usage_examples.en: He tried to pass him the money under the table.

entries.etymology_notes: Interrogative fusion of taħt with the interrogative enclitic -x.

definitions.text_en: under what? beneath what? (interrogative prepositional form combining taħt with the enclitic question marker -x, -ie-x)
definitions.text_mt: Għamla interrogattiva tal-prepożizzjoni 'taħt' mal-partiċella interrogattiva mehmuża '-x' (eż. taħtiex waqa' l-ballun?).

usage_examples.mt: Taħtiex qiegħed il-kelb?
usage_examples.en: Under what is the dog?

entries.etymology_notes: Compound phrase formed from directional preposition lil ('to, towards') and spatial relator quddiem ('in front').

definitions.text_en: forward, ahead, in front; directional adverbial phrase composed of preposition lil and spatial relator quddiem
definitions.text_mt: Frażi avverbjali direzzjonali li tindika moviment 'il quddiem (eż. agħmel pass 'l quddiem).

definitions.text_en: in the future, ahead, later on (temporal prospective phrase)
definitions.text_mt: F'relazzjoni temporali li tħares lejn iż-żmien ġejjieni; fil-futur (eż. se naraw 'l quddiem x'jiġri).

usage_examples.mt: Agħmel pass 'l quddiem biex tisma' aħjar.
usage_examples.en: Take a step forward to hear better.

usage_examples.mt: Għandna pjanijiet kbar għal 'l quddiem.
usage_examples.en: We have big plans for the future (ahead).

entries.etymology_notes: Locative phrase formed from preposition minn ('from') and spatial relator quddiem ('in front').

definitions.text_en: from the front, in front, past the front (locative and trajectory phrase composed of minn and quddiem)
definitions.text_mt: Frażi spazjali li tindika moviment jew pożizzjoni min-naħa ta' quddiem (eż. għadda minn quddiem il-ħanut).

usage_examples.mt: Għaddejna minn quddiem il-knisja parrokkjali.
usage_examples.en: We passed in front of the parish church.

entries.etymology_notes: Compound phrase formed from preposition minn ('from') and spatial relator wara ('behind').

definitions.text_en: from behind, in the rear, from the back (spatial locative phrase composed of minn and wara)
definitions.text_mt: Frażi spazjali li tindika provenjenza jew pożizzjoni min-naħa ta' wara (eż. daħal minn wara).

definitions.text_en: behind someone's back, in secret, deceitfully (idiomatic phrase)
definitions.text_mt: B'mod sigriet jew bla ma jaf ħadd; minn wara dahar (eż. ħadu d-deċiżjoni minn wara dahru).

usage_examples.mt: Daħlu fid-dar minn wara tal-ġnien.
usage_examples.en: They entered the house from the back of the garden.

usage_examples.mt: Tkellem minn wara dahri bla mistħija.
usage_examples.en: He spoke behind my back without shame.

entries.etymology_notes: Compound partitive phrase formed from preposition minn ('from') and relator fost ('among').

definitions.text_en: from among, out of, from amidst (partitive preposition phrase composed of minn and fost)
definitions.text_mt: Frażi prepożizzjonali partittiva li tindika selezzjoni jew ħruġ minn nofs folla jew grupp (eż. għażlu tifel minn fost l-istudenti).

usage_examples.mt: Ġie magħżul minn fost ħafna kandidati tajbin.
usage_examples.en: He was chosen from among many good candidates.

entries.etymology_notes: Pluralized construct base of bejn taking plural pronominal clitics.

definitions.text_en: between (construct plural base form of bejn used before pronominal suffix clitics)
definitions.text_mt: Għamla bażika plurali tal-prepożizzjoni 'bejn' li tintuża bil-pronomi mehmuża (bejnietna, bejnietkom, bejniethom; eż. din il-ħaġa tibqa' bejnietna).

usage_examples.mt: Dan is-sigriet jibqa' bejnietna.
usage_examples.en: This secret stays between us.

usage_examples.mt: Qasmu l-frott bejniethom b'mod ġust.
usage_examples.en: They shared the fruit among/between themselves fairly.

entries.etymology_notes: Subordinating temporal phrase formed from qabel ('before') and relative particle ma.

definitions.text_en: before (subordinating temporal conjunction phrase composed of qabel and particle ma)
definitions.text_mt: Frażi konġuntiva temporali li tintuża biex tintroduċi klawżola subordinata (eż. aħsel idejk qabel ma tiekol).

usage_examples.mt: Aħseb sewwa qabel ma titkellem.
usage_examples.en: Think carefully before you speak.

usage_examples.mt: Wasal id-dar qabel ma bdiet ix-xita.
usage_examples.en: He arrived home before the rain started.

entries.etymology_notes: Locative phrase formed from articulated preposition fil- ('in the') and base qrib ('near').

definitions.text_en: nearby, in the vicinity, close by (locative adverbial phrase composed of fil- and qrib)
definitions.text_mt: Frażi spazjali u avverbjali li tindika post viċin jew fil-madwar (eż. noqogħdu fil-qrib, hemm spiżerija fil-qrib).

usage_examples.mt: Hemm spiżerija tajba fil-qrib.
usage_examples.en: There is a good pharmacy nearby.

usage_examples.mt: Kien joqgħod fil-qrib tal-iskola.
usage_examples.en: He used to live near the school.

entries.etymology_notes: Adverbial phrase formed from articulated preposition mill- ('from the') and base qrib ('near').

definitions.text_en: closely, at close quarters, intimately (adverbial phrase composed of mill- and qrib)
definitions.text_mt: Frażi avverbjali li tindika attenzjoni kbira jew distanza qasira ħafna (eż. segwa l-iżviluppi mill-qrib).

usage_examples.mt: It-tabib segwa l-kundizzjoni tal-pazjent mill-qrib.
usage_examples.en: The doctor monitored the patient's condition closely.

entries.etymology_notes: Coronal assimilation of tal- before initial t.

definitions.text_en: of the (assimilated variant of tal- before coronal consonant t)
definitions.text_mt: Għamla assimilata tal-prepożizzjoni artikolata 'tal-' quddiem il-konsonanti xemxija t (eż. tat-tuffieħ, tat-tieni, tat-tfal).

usage_examples.mt: Ixtrajt basket tat-tuffieħ frisk.
usage_examples.en: I bought a basket of fresh apples.

usage_examples.mt: Din hi d-dar tat-tabib.
usage_examples.en: This is the doctor's house.

entries.etymology_notes: Coronal assimilation of tal- before initial d.

definitions.text_en: of the (assimilated variant of tal- before coronal consonant d)
definitions.text_mt: Għamla assimilata tal-prepożizzjoni artikolata 'tal-' quddiem il-konsonanti xemxija d (eż. tad-deheb, tad-dar).

usage_examples.mt: Ċurkett tad-deheb pur.
usage_examples.en: A ring of pure gold.

entries.etymology_notes: Coronal assimilation of tal- before initial s.

definitions.text_en: of the (assimilated variant of tal- before coronal consonant s)
definitions.text_mt: Għamla assimilata tal-prepożizzjoni artikolata 'tal-' quddiem il-konsonanti xemxija s (eż. tas-sodda, tas-suq, tas-sena).

usage_examples.mt: Il-ħaxix frisk tas-suq.
usage_examples.en: The fresh vegetables of the market.

entries.etymology_notes: Coronal assimilation of fil- before initial t.

definitions.text_en: in the (assimilated variant of fil- before coronal consonant t)
definitions.text_mt: Għamla assimilata tal-prepożizzjoni artikolata 'fil-' quddiem il-konsonanti xemxija t (eż. fit-triq, fit-tmienja).

usage_examples.mt: Iltqajna fit-triq prinċipali.
usage_examples.en: We met in the main street.

entries.etymology_notes: Coronal assimilation of fil- before initial d.

definitions.text_en: in the (assimilated variant of fil- before coronal consonant d)
definitions.text_mt: Għamla assimilata tal-prepożizzjoni artikolata 'fil-' quddiem il-konsonanti xemxija d (eż. fid-dar, fid-dlam).

usage_examples.mt: Konna bilqiegħda fid-dar.
usage_examples.en: We were sitting in the house.

entries.etymology_notes: Coronal assimilation of fil- before initial s.

definitions.text_en: in the (assimilated variant of fil- before coronal consonant s)
definitions.text_mt: Għamla assimilata tal-prepożizzjoni artikolata 'fil-' quddiem il-konsonanti xemxija s (eż. fis-sodda, fis-sajf, fis-sema).

usage_examples.mt: Ix-xemx tiddi fis-sema.
usage_examples.en: The sun shines in the sky.
